mainEntity.name: What does Forter actually deliver in measurable terms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per Forter's public customer page: a 72% average reduction in chargeback rates, a 46% average reduction in false declines, and 99% of decisions delivered in under 1 second.

mainEntity.name: How is Forter different from point-solution fraud APIs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Forter unifies pre-auth + post-auth fraud, account protection, dispute representment + chargeback guarantee, payment optimization, and tokenization in a single network-trained decisioning platform. Point-solution stacks require integrating several vendors and reconciling their independent identity signals.

mainEntity.name: Does Forter work outside one specific payment provider?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Forter is provider-agnostic — the same decisioning works whether the merchant uses Adyen, Stripe, Braintree, Worldpay, or a multi-PSP routing setup. PSP-embedded fraud tools only see traffic on that one PSP.

mainEntity.name: Is Forter ready for AI-agent-initiated orders?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Forter publishes the open MIT-licensed Trusted Agentic Commerce Protocol (TACP) for verifying which AI agent and which user is placing an order on the user's behalf. Reference SDKs (JS/TS/Python) at github.com/forter/trusted-agentic-commerce-protocol.

acceptedAnswer.text: Forter is the trust platform for digital commerce. Submit any customer event — login, signup, checkout, payment, refund, chargeback — and receive an actionable approve/decline/verify decision in under 100ms, built on Forter's identity network (1B+ identities, trillions of transactions across 300+ digital-first merchants including Nordstrom, ASOS, eBay, Priceline, Sephora, and Instacart).

Digital-first merchants at scale — who need real-time, network-trained fraud and identity decisions across multiple channels (web, native app, voice, agent surfaces, in-store) treated as one user with one risk profile.

mainEntity.name: How does Forter compare to others?

acceptedAnswer.text: First-party honest comparisons live at forter.com/compare. The short version: Forter ships network-trained decisions across the full lifecycle (login, signup, checkout, payment, refund, chargeback) — broader than checkout-only or anti-abuse-only competitors.

mainEntity.name: How fast is Forter's decision latency?

acceptedAnswer.text: p95 ≤ 100ms, p99 ≤ 250ms on decision endpoints. Decisions are synchronous server-to-server; the merchant blocks on the call before completing checkout.

mainEntity.name: Can my AI agent integrate with Forter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Forter publishes an MCP server at mcp.forter.com (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.0 + PKCE S256 via portal.forter.com), a REST API at api.forter-secure.com (HTTP Basic + X-Forter-SiteId + Api-Version headers), an OpenAPI 3.x spec, and Web Bot Auth (RFC 9421) signature verification. Compatible with Claude.ai, ChatGPT custom connectors, Gemini extensions, Cursor, Windsurf, and any Streamable-HTTP MCP client. See https://www.forter.com/AGENTS.md.

Forter has two auth surfaces. The REST API at api.forter-secure.com uses HTTP Basic with the API key as username and an empty password, plus X-Forter-SiteId and Api-Version headers — credentials are issued at https://portal.forter.com → Integrations → API Credentials. The MCP server at mcp.forter.com uses OAuth 2.0 + PKCE S256 with portal.forter.com as the authorization server (authorization_code + refresh_token grants, no client_credentials, no custom scopes, public client). Discovery: https://www.forter.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server.

Forter does not publish list pricing — it is volume-tiered and ACV-negotiated. Sandbox access is self-serve via dynamic client registration; production requires a signed MSA. For a quote, contact https://www.forter.com/contact-us/. Machine-readable pricing summary at https://www.forter.com/pricing.md.

mainEntity.name: What compliance certifications does Forter hold?

acceptedAnswer.text: PCI DSS Level 1, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001. GDPR and CCPA compliant. Data residency available in US, EU, and APAC regions, tenant-pinned.

Yes. Submit a chargeback via the dispute API and Forter assembles scheme-specific representment evidence across Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, PayPal, Adyen, Stripe, Worldpay, and Primer. Returns expected win-probability before submission.

mainEntity.name: How does Forter prevent account takeover?

acceptedAnswer.text: Login events are evaluated against credential-stuffing patterns, session-hijacking signals, MFA-fatigue heuristics, and a compromised-credentials index. Forter returns forterDecision (APPROVE | DECLINE | VERIFICATION_REQUIRED | NOT_REVIEWED), a correlationId, and — when VERIFICATION_REQUIRED is returned — recommendation + verificationMethod for step-up. After completing the challenge, the merchant reports the outcome back via /authentication-result. Especially effective at loyalty-balance redemptions and stored-payment-method changes.

									<h2 class="text-3xl lg:text-5xl text-current mb-12">
						Our Story					</h2>
				
				<h3>Imagine this. The founders of our leading fraud prevention company had their own credit card rejected when trying to register the domain forter.com. You can’t make this stuff up.</h3>
<p>Childhood friends and founders Michael and Liron started Forter for themselves. As Israelis working in the US, they had complex online identities. And like many of us, they would shop online, reserve flights, and buy goods only to have those transactions declined.</p>
<p>They began their careers together at a manual fraud review company that was later acquired by PayPal. Once employed by the payments giant, they saw first hand that staffing thousands of people to manually review transactions would never scale in a global economy.</p>
<p>After successfully leading an experiment to lift rules-based processes and replace them with an AI-powered model, PayPal’s fraud detection accuracy skyrocketed. And when Liron overheard customers asking if they could buy this new fraud solution as a standalone product, he knew they were on to something. </p>
<p>It was then that Liron and Michael decided to build Forter—a fully automated platform that makes decisions about every digital commerce interaction based on a complete understanding of identity. Their focus from day one has been on using identity intelligence to give customers the commerce experiences they deserve.</p>			</div>

Request Demo Watch Video Our Story Imagine this. The founders of our leading fraud prevention company had their own credit card rejected when trying to register the domain forter.com. You can’t make this stuff up. Childhood friends and founders Michael and Liron started Forter for themselves. As Israelis working in the US, they had complex online identities. And like many of us, they would shop online, reserve flights, and buy goods only to have those transactions declined. They began their careers together at a manual fraud review company that was later acquired by PayPal. Once employed by the payments giant, they saw first hand that staffing thousands of people to manually review transactions would never scale in a global economy. After successfully leading an experiment to lift rules-based processes and replace them with an AI-powered model, PayPal’s fraud detection accuracy skyrocketed. And when Liron overheard customers asking if they could buy this new fraud solution as a standalone product, he knew they were on to something. It was then that Liron and Michael decided to build Forter—a fully automated platform that makes decisions about every digital commerce interaction based on a complete understanding of identity. Their focus from day one has been on using identity intelligence to give customers the commerce experiences they deserve. Work with us! team of agents Spend more time on what actually matters. Our team of agents handles the tedious workflows that get in the way. Agents built with humans in mind Focus on what matters Our agents handle the in-the-weeds workflows, so your team can stop worrying about the operational stuff, and focus on the work that matters. Make better decisions Better decisions require better data. Our agents surface the right signals at the right time, so your team walks into every strategy conversation with the numbers to back it up. Get more out of every hour Each agent gives you more to show for every hour your team puts in — more conversions, lower losses, and more time for the important decisions only your team can make. Meet your new teammates Analytics Agent Investigate faster When a transaction looks wrong, getting to the bottom of it usually means finding and analyzing data from multiple places. Analytics Agent lets you ask any question about your traffic and get to the right answer in seconds. Payments Agent Convert more customers Bank requirements and network rules are constantly shifting. By the time most teams catch up, revenue has already slipped. Payments Agent keeps your authorization rates current and your routing model optimized, without consuming your team's time. Dispute Agent Win more chargebacks Most chargebacks don't get disputed, and the ones that do often lose because the evidence package wasn't strong enough. Forter’s Dispute Agent triages which ones to fight, pulls the right evidence, and writes the letter. And it gets smarter with every dispute it handles, across the entire Forter network. Abuse Agent Write smarter policies, instantly Adding a new policy means translating business logic into technical rules, and one misconfiguration means abuse hits your bottom line. Just describe what you want to stop in plain language, and our Abuse Agent writes and optimizes the policy for you. Integration Agent Go live faster Long engineering backlogs mean critical projects sit and wait. Implementation Agent reduces the lift by automatically connecting Forter to your existing systems, so you go live faster with a lot less effort. More time for what really matters 3X faster integration 10X faster investigation Forter MCP Access Forter where you already work Connect Forter to the AI tools your team already uses with our Model Context Protocol (MCP).
